title: EEEEEGone
logline: A steady, relentless build from near-nothing into giant crossing waves of notes, swelling until every single key is in use and the density feels like a million notes — and it stays there.
energy_shape: steady relentless build, never resetting, through gathering wave layers into a full-keyboard maximal-density overload that holds at the extreme through the final bar — no come-down, no decay
tempo_feel: driving, accelerating from a moderate pulse into a relentless machine-gun extreme
imagery: giant waves crossing in and out of each other
a swarm growing until it blots out the sky
every key on the piano lit at once
must_have_moments: giant wave layers that visibly criss-cross in and out of each other
by the climax, every single key on the keyboard is in use
note density that feels like a million notes
stays at the extreme through the final bar, no decay or quiet ending
avoid: starting at full extreme — this one must build
notes: Target near-maximal note density (zenith_extreme_density profile) so the piece reads as ~1M notes. Use multiple `wave` layers with different wavelength_bars/strand counts so the waves visibly criss-cross.
